need.reads.text: Reads the text of the open adventure
need.reads.codex: Reads the codex of the open adventure
need.changes.suggests: Suggests changes, which you accept or reject
need.changes.writes: Changes the open adventure directly, each change one undo step, only when you ask it to
need.setting: Connects to the address you enter in its settings (“{setting}”)
consent.title: Install {name} {version}?
unverified: Unverified: runs program code; only install from people you trust.
installed: {name} {version} is installed. Switch it on below.
notExtension: That file is not an extension. Modules are installed in Settings ▸ Modules.
note: Extensions add functions to Scriptorum with their own program code. An installed extension does nothing until you switch it on.
blockedNote: Connections outside the app are blocked, so extensions that need the internet cannot reach it. You can change this in Settings ▸ Application.
secretKeychain: Kept in this computer's own keychain, never in a settings file.
secretFile: This computer has no keychain Scriptorum can use, so it is kept in a file in Scriptorum's own folder that only your user can read.
confirmRemove: Remove {name}? Its settings, any key it stored and its files are removed too.
changed: {name} changed the text: {label}. Undo takes it back.
findingsFrom: From {name}: {count} found. Click one to go to its place.
